violation_type.title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2405(2))
violation_type.short_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Crib for Each Non-walking Infant Younger Than 12 Months of Age
violation_type.typical_finding: No cribs were observed in the infant room.

finding_variants.text: No cribs were observed in the infant room.
The operation did not have a crib in the infant room for each present today.  The operation is using mattresses on the floor for non-walking children.
A nine month old infant, who does not walk, was observed to be utilizing a cot for napping.
A non-walking 11 month old was sleeping on a mat.
An infant enrolled at the operation did not have an assigned crib.
Infant's 0-11 months old were observed using crib mattresses on the floor and not cribs to sleep in.
